language_phone_hint: Omnileaf uses your phone's language unless you pick one.

language_more_coming: More languages arrive as people translate Omnileaf.

privacy_nothing_leaves_tablet: Nothing leaves this tablet unless you send a report or connect a tracker.
privacy_nothing_leaves_computer: Nothing leaves this computer unless you send a report or connect a tracker.

crash_report_copy_failed: Couldn't copy the details. Try again.
crash_report_browser_unavailable: Couldn't open your browser. Try again.
crash_report_not_sent: Couldn't send the report. Try again.
animations_intro: All four are on until you turn them off. Each switch works at once; with one off, those things appear and go without moving.
animations_navigation_help: Screens slide in and out, and the tab bar's highlight moves.
animations_navigation_help_desktop: Pages change with a short fade, and the sidebar's highlight moves.
animations_sheets_help: Sheets, menus, dialogs and toasts slide or grow into place.
animations_reader_help: The reader's bars and its sheets slide and fade.
animations_reader_help_desktop: The reader's bars, Reading settings and Jump to a book slide and fade.
animations_loading_help: Placeholders pulse and progress bars fill smoothly. Spinners always turn, at half speed with this off.
animations_reduce_motion: Reduce motion in your phone's settings already turns slides and springs into fades or nothing everywhere, whatever you choose here.
animations_reduce_motion_desktop: Reduce motion in your computer's settings already turns slides and springs into fades or nothing everywhere, whatever you choose here.
animations_page_turns: Page turns are set in Reading settings.
advanced_note_body: These tools are only in development builds and never ship.
advanced_scheduled_rescans: Check folders for new books while Omnileaf is open
advanced_scheduled_rescans_help: New books show up without a rescan. Turn off to save battery.
crash_test_panic_body: Panics on a background thread, then offers the report the way the next launch would.
crash_test_interface_body: Throws an error the interface doesn't handle; its report is offered straight away.
crash_test_quit_body: Panics and quits. Open Omnileaf again to see the report it kept.
crash_test_quit_note: It quits straight away. Open it again to see the crash report it kept.

reader_time_left_short: Less than a minute left in this chapter

reader_auto_scroll_help: Keeps scrolling with reduced motion on, since you started it.
reader_pause_at_end: Pause auto scroll at the end of a book
reader_auto_scroll_pace_help: Starts auto scroll at your own speed.

reader_guide_click_body_rtl: Click the left third for the next page and the right third to go back. Click the middle to show the controls. ← and Space work too.

reader_shortcuts_escape: Esc closes an open panel first, then leaves full screen, then goes back. The mouse's back button goes back too.
reader_shortcuts_reversed: In right to left, ← turns to the next page and → goes back.
reader_applies_to_all: Changes here apply to every series.
reader_fit_zoom_hint: Pinch or double-tap a page to zoom.
reader_skip_this_screen_help: Go straight on next time. Also in Settings › Reader.
